note: Daily scan 13 Nov: new tanker strike off Ras Al Khaimah, escalation rhetoric, and a minister's call for spare capacity and harder infrastructure. Cyber items found were older than 14 days.

signals.summary: Crude tanker Dominica Prosperity was hit in the engine room by a projectile about 14 nm NW of Ras Al Khaimah on 11 Nov (UKMTO); fire broke out and the UAE Coast Guard evacuated all 22 crew. JMIC counts 181 maritime incidents since 1 Mar, and about 211 ships sit idle at anchorages east of Hormuz incl. Fujairah and Khor Fakkan.
signals.check: Third projectile strike in UAE waters in two days. Check lead times and shipping routes for critical imported spares (transformers, cables, meters) and whether suppliers are using Fujairah/Khor Fakkan anchorages now congested.
signals.notes: Opened gCaptain (12 Nov), citing UKMTO, Ambrey and JMIC. Distinct from SQ-0081 (Lima, 10 Nov) and SQ-0082 (Fujairah Energy). Also NCC Fajr hit north of Khasab on 11 Nov.

signals.source: Gulf News / Khaleej Times / TradeArabia: UAE business and utilities
signals.summary: On 12 Nov Iran's Mohsen Rezaei said US bases 'from West Asia to Europe' would be legitimate targets if Washington starts another war; Israel's caretaker defence minister said no approval is needed for fresh operations; Trump said the US does not need a deal. Saudi Arabia intercepted Houthi missiles and drones aimed at Mecca and Riyadh regions. UAE airspace stays open.
signals.check: Rhetoric points to a risk of renewed strikes. Confirm the crisis and business continuity plans are at the right alert level and that control-centre and substation staff know the shelter procedures.
signals.notes: Opened Gulf News evening briefing (12 Nov, grade C). No attack on the UAE reported that day. Relevant to ER-02; recheck against an official UAE or wire source.

signals.source: Gulf News / Khaleej Times / TradeArabia: UAE business and utilities
signals.summary: At ADIPEC the UAE Minister of Energy and Infrastructure said the country cannot return to business as usual: critical energy infrastructure designs, including electricity, will be reviewed to add protective layers, and the UAE must build spare capacity and 'assume the worst'. No timeline or cost given.
signals.check: Likely to lead to new resilience and redundancy requirements for networks. Track any DoE or ministry design standards and check capital plans allow for added protection and N-1 margins.
signals.notes: Opened Khaleej Times (2 Nov). Policy direction, not yet a rule. Relevant to ER-02 and ER-08.
